# `SEC_SECRET_IN_CONFIG`

| | |
|---|---|
| Severity | error |
| Area | [Security (`SEC_`)](README.md#domain-sec) |
| Reported by | `cli` |

## What happened

The config file contains a token- or password-like literal; the run stops.

## What to do

Move the secret to an env variable (`HOLOTYPE_SB_TOKEN`) or `holotype login`, and rotate it if the file was shared.
